title: Managed Database: customer request filing
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database customer request filing applies to database request. Only the customer may file or cancel an authorization, claim or disposal request. Preserve the exact external reference and the narrowest original source reference. Set filing time and occurrence time to the current handling clock and status pending on filing; cancellation is a new request event with status cancelled linked to the original request. An unsupported channel is refused. A repeated identical request reference returns the existing event. Filing a request never confirms a system approval or changes an accounting balance.
